dedupe_keys.name: qatar building permits and building completion certificates by municipality type and month national planning council data gov qa

description: This family of about twenty tables on Qatar's national open data portal, published by the National Planning Council, counts building permits and building completion certificates issued in the State of Qatar. There are national monthly tables of permits by type (new buildings, additions and fencing, excluding maintenance permits) and of completion certificates by type; one monthly permit table and one certificate table for each municipality (Doha, Al Rayyan, Al Wakrah, Umm Slal, Al Khor and Al Thakhira, Al Daayen, Al Shamal and Al Shahhaniya), the Doha series running from 2016 to 2023; and totals by municipality, building type and permit type such as villas, multi-storey buildings, commercial buildings, mosques and dwellings under housing loans for 2021 to 2023, with labels in English and Arabic. Coverage: all eight municipalities of Qatar. Access: each table can be viewed, exported and queried through the Opendatasoft explore API; the entries were modified between June and September 2026. Licence: CC BY 4.0; free. Caveats: these are counts, not a register of individual permits or buildings, and there are no locations below municipality; the portal also holds related tables such as Ashghal completed public building projects by type. Simulation uses are construction activity and stock growth trends by municipality for exposure updating and capacity planning. Related records: the US Census building permits survey; the Montevideo approved building permits.
